value.summary: The change refactors the hive episode loop to support multi-turn rounds: the library's `HiveStep::Speak` now returns a `turns` vector and a `next_state` to commit once all turns are appended, rather than a single turn with its own `next_state`. The corresponding fixture updates in `deliberation_test.rs`, `moves_test.rs`, and `test.rs` reflect the new split of watermark/round_start out of the old nested `EpisodeState::opened`. The import-path fixups throughout the codebase adjust for a restructuring of the vendored `openhuman-core` crate. No test failures, uncovered branches, or regressions in changed behaviour are visible in the diff.
